Allow camera access to scan a QR code.

Scanning happens on this device. Camera frames and QR contents are not uploaded or saved by the scanner. After recognition, the existing import or pairing step opens. Back cancels scanning.\n\nKeep the entire code visible. If it is blurred, move the phone farther away, enlarge the displayed code, or tap the preview to refocus. Use the light when needed.
